title: 第9章 海流沙第10章 孪生姐妹
lines: “亲爱的，还记得这把匕首吗？这是你当初送我的礼物，我一直贴身带在身上。从你背叛我的那一刻起，我便发誓，一定要用这把匕首亲手杀了你。”
声音传来，海流沙微微摆动螓首，看着书桌上的玻璃杯，通过镜面的反射，一名神情孤傲冷峻的青年立刻出现在她的美眸中。
感受到匕首刀锋刺骨的冰冷，她表现得异常冷静，仿佛在她身边的并非杀手，而是一位久违的朋友。
“难得再次相遇，你不准备说点什么吗？”见海流沙迟迟没有开口，江来嘴角微扬，露出一丝温和的笑意。但是，在他的笑容底下，隐藏着凌冽的杀机。
“我听不明白你在说什么，但我可以很确定的告诉你，我不认识你，所以你不用浪费唇舌。我只有一个要求，在我死之前，我想知道是谁委派你来杀我的。”
“不认识我？”江来一怔，一股无名之火不自觉的从心底涌现。他怎么都没想到，再次相逢，对方竟然说出这等绝情的话语。
他深吸了一口气，平复着怒火，一字一顿道：“卿曼容，都到这个时候了，你还有必要演戏吗？我必须承认，我以前小看了你，没想到你一直扮演着两个角色，难怪我们在一起的时候，你经常借口离开，一走十天半月，原来你还有另一个身份。你知道吗？当我在电视上看到你照片时，还以为是自己的幻觉，但是，我跟你相处了那么久，你身上的每一寸肌肤我都了如指掌，绝不会认错。”
“卿曼容？”海流沙喃喃自语，一抹异色从美眸中闪过，随即隐没在深处。
“你还不准备承认吗？”江来的笑容渐渐变冷，厉声道：“我万里迢迢跑到QZ市，可不是为了看你演戏。我信任你，在你面前没有任何秘密，可你却背叛我，在背后捅我刀子，害我险些丧命。你应该知道，所有人都在盯着我的位子，想要取而代之，因为你的那一刀，让那群家伙看到了机会。为了保护我的安全，我手下几个兄弟全都战死，而这一切都是拜你所赐！”
面对他的愤怒和恨意，海流沙丝毫不为所动，神情淡漠道：“我很同情你的遭遇，可惜，我不是你要找的那个人。”
“同情？哼！”江来冷笑道：“你觉得我需要你的同情吗？不！我只要你的命。”话落，他抓住海流沙的香肩，一把将她从椅子上提了起来，按在旁边的墙壁上。
凝视着眼前这张过无数次出现在梦中的熟悉面容，他内心的恨意疯狂涌动，眼中戾气遍布。只要想到这个女人所做的一切，他便心如刀绞，痛不欲生。这段时间以来，他曾无数次在梦中幻想二人再次相见的场景，自己该如何报复她，才能化解心中的仇恨。
可是，真到了这个时候，他的心中却有些不忍。
爱之深，恨之切。他对她刻骨铭心的仇恨，全都源于对她的爱。当他遇到她的那一刻，以为自己的一生找到了归宿，却没想到自己的一生都葬送在她手中。
看着他眼中流露出的犹豫和交织的复杂情绪，海流沙的心莫名其妙被触动了一般，有些不忍。天知道那个女人对他造成了多大的伤害，才让他如此痛苦。
“其实……你还是深爱着她，不然的话，你不会这么难以抉择。”
“你闭嘴！”江来忍不住怒喝道：“卿曼容，就算你对我是逢场作戏，但是，两年的朝夕相触，难道你对我一点感情都没有吗？到了现在，你还百般否认，以为换个身份就能抹去我们以前经历的点点滴滴。我告诉你，不可能！”
“够了！”
此刻，海流沙也动了火气。这几天遭遇的事情已经让她感到很糟心了，结果还莫名其妙的被误认成另一个女人。更有意思的是，无论她如何解释，眼前这个男人就是不肯相信。如果这个男人是受人雇佣来杀她海流沙，她无话可说。可是，她不想糊里糊涂的替另一个女人去死。
面对她表现出的不耐烦，江来冷笑道：“终于忍不住要承认了吗？”
“我再说一遍，我叫海流沙，是南月集团的董事长，不是你要找的卿曼容。”
“好，好，很好！”
当她的话音落下，暴怒中的江来突然冷静了下来，缓缓点头，只是，那双杀意浓烈的瞳仁中渐渐泛起一丝狰狞之色。紧接着，他目光下移，打量着对方的穿着。
也许是因为在家，海流沙穿得并不正式，很随意的搭配，里面一件宽松的白色T恤，外面披着灰色的针织帽衫，下身穿着一条九分牛仔裤，裤脚呈喇叭状，衬托出修长圆润的美腿和丰腴的臀部。
“一段时间不见，你的身材还是一如既往的完美。”江来嘴角微扬，似笑非笑，但海流沙却感受到他笑容中隐藏的冷酷，心中莫名的涌现出一丝不安。
“你……你想干什么？”她支支吾吾，身体下意识的往后退了退，可她很快意识到，自己的后背贴着墙壁，退无可退。
“你不是不肯承认自己是卿曼容吗？既然如此，我会慢慢证明给你看。”江来慢慢将脸庞凑到她的近前，盯着她那双灿若星辰般的美眸，缓缓道：“我认识的卿曼容，每次喝咖啡的时候都有一个习惯，六分奶四分糖，我刚在阳台偷听的时候，你的习惯恰好跟她一样，难道你想告诉我这是巧合？”
海流沙一怔，辩解道：“如果我说这是巧合，你肯定不会相信，因为你已经先入为主的把我当成了她。”
“你不承认没关系，我会一点一点剥开你的伪装，让你没办法否认。”
“好，那我倒要看看，你准备怎么证明！”
嘶！
突然间，伴随一阵撕裂声，海流沙还未反应过来，只觉胸口一凉，自己的T恤竟然被对方硬生生的用手撕扯开，露出白皙柔滑的肌肤，春光大泄，连穿戴在里面的粉色胸衣都显露了出来。
content_en:
"My dear, do you still remember this dagger? This was the gift you gave me, and I have always carried it close to me. From the moment you betrayed me, I swore that I would kill you with my own hands with this dagger."
When the voice came, Hai Liusha moved her head slightly and looked at the glass on the desk. Through the reflection of the mirror, a young man with an arrogant and stern expression immediately appeared in her beautiful eyes.
Feeling the biting coldness of the dagger blade, she acted extremely calm, as if the person beside her was not a killer but a long-lost friend.
"It's rare to meet again, aren't you going to say something?" Seeing Hai Liusha still didn't speak, Jiang Lai raised the corner of his mouth slightly, revealing a gentle smile. However, underneath his smile, there was a murderous intention hidden.
"I can't understand what you are talking about, but I can tell you with certainty that I don't know you, so you don't need to waste your words. I only have one request. Before I die, I want to know who appointed you to kill me."
"Don't know me?" Jiang Lai was startled, and an unknown fire emerged from the bottom of his heart unconsciously. He never expected that when they met again, the other party would say such heartless words.
He took a deep breath, calmed down his anger, and said word by word: "Qing Manrong, it's now this time, do you still need to act? I must admit that I underestimated you before, but I didn't expect you to play two roles all the time. No wonder you often borrowed the words when we were together. After leaving for ten and a half months, it turns out that you have another identity. Do you know? When I saw your photo on TV, I thought it was my hallucination. However, I have been with you for so long, and I know every inch of your body, and I will never admit it. "
"Qing Manrong?" Hai Liusha murmured to himself, a strange color flashed through his beautiful eyes, and then disappeared into the depths.
"Aren't you ready to admit it?" Jiang Lai's smile gradually turned cold and he said sternly: "I came all the way to QZ City not to watch you act. I trust you and have no secrets in front of you, but you betrayed me and stabbed me in the back, putting me in danger. They lost their lives. You should know that everyone is eyeing my position and wanting to take my place. Because of your knife, those guys saw an opportunity. In order to protect my safety, all my brothers died, and all of this was thanks to you!"
Facing his anger and hatred, Hai Liusha remained unmoved and said with an indifferent expression: "I sympathize with your experience, but unfortunately, I am not the person you are looking for."
"Sympathy? Humph!" Jiang Lai sneered: "Do you think I need your sympathy? No! I only want your life." After saying that, he grabbed Hai Liusha's shoulders, lifted her up from the chair, and pressed her against the wall next to her.
Staring at the familiar face that had appeared in his dreams countless times before him, the hatred in his heart surged crazily, and his eyes were full of hostility. Just thinking about what this woman had done made him feel like he was in agony. During this period of time, he had fantasized about the scene where the two met again in his dreams countless times, and how he could retaliate against her in order to resolve the hatred in his heart.
However, when it came to this moment, he couldn't bear it in his heart.
Deep love, deep hatred. His unforgettable hatred for her all stems from his love for her. When he met her, he thought he had found a destination in his life, but he didn't expect that his life would be ruined in her hands.
Seeing the hesitation and complicated emotions in his eyes, Hai Liusha's heart seemed to be touched inexplicably, and he couldn't bear it. God knows how much harm that woman caused him to cause him so much pain.
"Actually... you still love her deeply, otherwise, you wouldn't be so difficult to make a choice."
"Shut up!" Jiang Lai couldn't help but yelled angrily: "Qing Manrong, even if you are just teasing me, but after two years of being in contact with me day and night, don't you have any feelings for me at all? Until now, you still deny it in every possible way, thinking that changing your identity can erase every bit of our previous experience. I tell you, it's impossible!"
"Enough!"
At this moment, Hai Liusha also became angry. The things she had experienced in the past few days had already made her feel terrible, and she was inexplicably mistaken for another woman. What's even more interesting is that no matter how she explains it, the man in front of her just refuses to believe it. If this man was hired to kill her, Hai Liusha, she had nothing to say. However, she didn't want to die for another woman in a daze.
Faced with her impatience, Jiang Lai sneered: "Can you finally admit it?"
"Let me say it again, my name is Hai Liusha, and I am the chairman of Nanyue Group. I am not the Qing Manrong you are looking for."
"Okay, okay, very good!"
When her words fell, Jiang Lai, who was furious, suddenly calmed down and nodded slowly, but a hint of ferocity gradually appeared in his eyes with strong murderous intent. Then, he moved his eyes downward and looked at the other party's clothes.
Perhaps it was because at home, Hai Liusha was not dressed formally, and was dressed casually. He wore a loose white T-shirt underneath, a gray knitted hoodie on the outside, and a pair of nine-point jeans with flared legs, which highlighted his long, round legs and plump buttocks.
"I haven't seen you for a while, but your figure is still as perfect as ever." Jiang Lai raised the corner of his mouth slightly, half-smiling, but Hai Liusha felt the coldness hidden in his smile, and felt an inexplicable uneasiness in his heart.
"You...what do you want to do?" She hesitated and subconsciously stepped back, but she soon realized that her back was pressed against the wall and there was no way to retreat.
"Aren't you unwilling to admit that you are Qing Manrong? In that case, I will slowly prove it to you." Jiang Lai slowly moved his face closer to hers, stared into her beautiful eyes like stars, and said slowly: "The Qing Manrong I know has a habit every time he drinks coffee, six points milk and four points sugar. When I was eavesdropping on the balcony, your habit happened to be the same as hers. Do you want to tell me this is a coincidence?"
Hai Liusha was startled and defended: "If I said it was a coincidence, you would not believe it, because you have already preconceived that I was her."
"It doesn't matter if you don't admit it. I will peel off your disguise bit by bit so that you can't deny it."
"Okay, then I want to see how you plan to prove it!"
Hiss!
Suddenly, there was a tearing sound, and before Hai Liusha could react, she felt a chill in her chest. Her T-shirt was torn open by the other party's hands, revealing her fair and smooth skin. She even revealed her pink bra.
title_en: Chapter 9 Quicksand in the Sea Chapter 10 Twin Sisters
